blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to the application log) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS when the user id suffices) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque user id (`log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`); logs are copied to aggregators and kept outside any erasure path (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 32).
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to the application log

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event properties and send only `user_id` (or a pseudonymous id); counting sign-ups needs no e-mail address (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c), Art. 25).
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS when the user id suffices

findings.recommendation: State in the proposal that Beacon is a new processor, confirm a data processing agreement exists and where it stores data (GDPR Art. 28, Chapter V if outside the EEA); a question for the team, not a code fix.
findings.title: New third-party processor Beacon is not identified in the plan

findings.evidence:
user_id = insert_user(email=email, display_name=display_name)
log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
track("signup", {"user_id": user_id, "email": email})
findings.recommendation: Define how long the member record is kept and how account deletion reaches it, the log lines and the Beacon events, backups included (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e), Art. 17).
findings.title: No retention or erasure defined for the new member data and its copies

findings.evidence: - [x] personal-data — collects e-mail addresses and display names
findings.recommendation: Ask the team to state in the proposal the purpose and lawful basis for the e-mail address, the display name and the analytics event (GDPR Art. 5(1)(b), Art. 6), and whether the display name is needed at sign-up.
findings.title: Purpose and lawful basis of the collected data are not stated
